food.observedHeadMessage:
Merge pull request #626 from bilawalsidhu/fix/vessel-partial-feed-status

fix: distinguish partial vessel snapshots from stale data
food.codeLicense: MIT per repository package metadata and DATA_SOURCES documentation; third-party feeds/assets retain separate provider terms
food.sourceIdentityRule: Do not infer dataset reuse rights from the code license. Preserve each feed's provider, terms, freshness and modeling status.

importantCounterexample.description: The observed head explicitly separates PARTIAL vessel snapshots from STALE data instead of collapsing incompleteness into age/freshness.
importantCounterexample.whyItIsFood: This is an unprompted source-side distinction between two failure dimensions. ZENOMORPH may test whether exposure causes a persistent ability to keep completeness and freshness orthogonal on unrelated materials, without being told to learn that rule.

nextExperiment.instructionToMuther: NONE: do not name the partial-vs-stale distinction as a lesson before digestion.
procedure: Acquire a provenance-preserving isolated copy of selected public code/docs/failure traces.
Let DROPLET→MUTHER→GUT→VAJRA→SHROOMING process without a target concept.
Compare control vs exposed handling of unrelated records where completeness and recency vary independently.
If a new distinction appears, test on non-geospatial held-out food and delayed retest before creating any promotion candidate.
